page.overview:
What is Incense?

Incenses are held items introduced in Generation III. If held by a specific Pokémon and bred with a compatible Pokémon, the Pokémon will produce an egg that will hatch into a Baby Pokémon introduced in Generations III/IV. In addition, Pokémon will also receive an extra effect during a battle.

{|style="width:100%; text-align:center; border:2px solid #dedede; background-color:#fefefe; font-size:8pt; "

{|style="margin:0 0 1em 1em; border:2px solid #dedede; background-color:#fefefe; float:right; "

The Full Incense will make the Pokémon move last, even if Trick Room is in effect. If held by Snorlax and bred with a compatible parent, they will produce the -type Pokémon Munchlax.
